meta.title: Threats, Harassment, or Blackmail: Cybercrime Report & Track
meta.description: Report online harassment, threats, or blackmail in a few plain-language steps. No login required.

progress.moreQuestions: {count, plural, one {# more question} other {# more questions}}

storageUnavailable: We can't save your progress in this browser. Try to finish in one go.

narrate.title: Tell us what happened
narrate.description: Write it in your own words. There's no right way to say it, and no minimum length.
narrate.narrativePlaceholder: e.g. Someone I matched with on Instagram is threatening to share photos of me unless I pay them...

facts.title: A few details
facts.description: Helps route this to the right place. Everything here is optional except confirming the category.
facts.ongoingLabel: Is this still happening right now?
facts.categorySuggestion: Based on what you wrote, this sounds like {label}. Is that right?
facts.categoryError: Confirm or choose a category to continue.

contact.title: Where + how to reach you
contact.description: That's all we ask. No ID, no parent's name, no date of birth.

mobileConsent.what: Send your Complaint ID and status updates on this case.
mobileConsent.who: The police unit your complaint is routed to. Nobody else.
mobileConsent.required: No. You still get your Complaint ID either way; this only adds SMS updates.

contact.savedFromProfileBody: We've filled in the state and district from your last report. You can change them.

evidence.title: Add evidence
evidence.description: Completely optional, your report is already valid without it. Screenshots of messages, the profile you're reporting, anything you have.
evidence.helperText: Images and PDFs, up to {maxSize} each, up to {maxFiles} files. Images are compressed on your device before upload.
evidence.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to {maxFiles} files.
evidence.unsupportedType: “{name}” isn't an image or PDF. You can skip evidence and submit without it.
evidence.scanNoticeBody: This is a hackathon prototype: files are checked and marked “simulated clean”, not scanned by a real anti-malware engine. Don't attach anything you wouldn't want stored on a demo system.
evidence.filesSelectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No files selected} one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
evidence.textFallbackLabel: Nothing to upload? Paste the details instead
evidence.textFallbackHelp: Usernames, phone numbers, message text, links: anything you can copy but not screenshot. This gets added to your report.
evidence.textFallbackPlaceholder: e.g. Their username is @example, and the messages started on...

review.title: Review
review.description: Here's what we'll send. Nothing is filed until you submit.
review.categoryLine: We think this is {label}. Is that right?
review.contactLine: You're in {district}, {state}. We'll reach you at {mobile}.
review.evidenceNone: No evidence attached. That's fine, it's optional.
review.evidenceAttached: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} attached: {files}
review.evidenceTextOnly: No files, but you pasted additional details. They'll be added to your report.

done.idCardDescription: Large, copyable, and yours to keep.
done.smsPreviewLabel: Here's the SMS we'd send you (simulated, nothing is actually sent)
done.evidenceDone: Evidence attached and marked “simulated clean”: not a real virus scan.
done.evidencePartial: Some evidence files were attached; others couldn't be saved (unsupported type or too large). Your report itself was still filed.
done.evidenceError: Evidence couldn't be attached, but your report was still filed successfully.
done.checklist1: Screenshot everything before you block: messages, the profile, any posts. Blocking first can lose your own evidence.
done.checklist2: Don't pay, don't respond to demands. Paying almost never makes it stop.
done.checklist3: If you're in immediate danger, call 1930 or your local police. This report is not a substitute for that.
done.nextBody: Your report has been received and is queued for review. This Complaint ID is not an FIR: it is a record that a report was made and is the reference the cyber cell will use.
done.updatesDescription: Optional. Verify your number and we'll link this report to it so you can check on it later. Skip if you'd rather not.
done.updatesLinkedBody: Your number is verified and linked to this report.
done.updatesSkipped: Skipped: your Complaint ID above still works on its own.
done.demoCodeBody: This is a hackathon prototype; no real SMS is sent. In production this code would arrive by text.
done.otpGenericError: Something went wrong confirming that code. Please try again.
done.downloadFileBody:
Cybercrime Report: Confirmation

Complaint ID: {publicId}

This is NOT an FIR.
Keep this ID safe; you will need it for any follow-up.

genericSubmitError: Something went wrong submitting your report. Please try again.
smsTemplate: Your cybercrime report is filed. Complaint ID: {publicId}. This is NOT an FIR. Save this ID; you will need it for any follow-up.
